Step-by-Step Guide

Tap any step timer to launch Cook Mode right there

restaurant_menu
1

Line Pan & Prep Base Ingredients

Line a loaf pan, baking dish, or serving glasses with parchment paper or chill them in the fridge for 5 minutes. Measure out 2 pcs ripe creamy avocados and 1/3 cup unsweetened dutch cocoa powder so your base whips up thick, creamy, and clump-free.

2

Blend Avocados, Cocoa & Maple

Blend 2 pcs ripe creamy avocados, 1/3 cup unsweetened dutch cocoa powder, and 1/4 cup pure maple syrup + 1 tsp vanilla + espresso pinch with 3 tbsp almond milk until glossy, piped-mousse smooth. Chill 20 mins. Chill or freeze until completely firm and set, then portion into 4 servings and store leftovers in an airtight container.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

A tiny pinch of espresso powder + sea salt makes it taste 100% like classic dark chocolate ganache.

3

Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish

Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter 1/4 cup pure maple syrup + 1 tsp vanilla + espresso pinch evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

4

Chill Until Firm, Slice & Store

Cover and refrigerate 5-Min Avocado Silk Dark Chocolate Mousse until completely firm and sliceable. Portion into 4 servings, add any crisp toppings right before serving, and keep leftovers chilled in an airtight container for up to 5 days.

Nutrition, Storage & Healthy Prep Notes

CALORIES215 kcal
SERVINGS4
SUGAR MODEZero Refined

Make-Ahead & Storage: Keep 5-min avocado silk dark chocolate mousse in an airtight glass container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days (or freeze individual portions up to 1 month). Pair with unsweetened Greek yogurt, fresh berries, or espresso for a balanced treat.

Keto & Low-Sugar Tip: Toggle Healthy Swap above to substitute refined sugar with monk fruit or coconut sugar and white flour with oat or almond flour.
